subject: Urgent: venue AV bridge + booth glass crack + keynote delay — recovery plan
content:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: venue AV bridge + booth glass crack + keynote delay — recovery plan

Team,

Just arrived onsite at Harbor Convention Center and we have three simultaneous problems that need immediate coordination:

1) Main AV bridge (mixer) for Hall B is not powering on — venue tech says "no boot". Without it we lose live projection and the stream to the sponsor channel.
2) Booth 12A (Redwood) has a cracked glass side panel from transit — dangerous shards and we cannot open the booth until it's contained.
3) Keynote speaker (Samantha Li) texted: flight mechanical delay, ETA unknown — she may miss the 10:30 slot.

Proposed short plan (please action immediately):
- LiveAV Solutions: priority dispatch to Hall B to bring a backup mixer + streaming encoder. If they can’t replace the mixer, use backup projector + laptop stream on isolated network (fallback).
- ExpoFix: emergency acrylic panel + quick mount to seal off booth glass so staff can operate safely.
- Moderator/backup speaker: Marcus, can you confirm if Alex Martinez is available to run a short fireside to bridge the keynote gap? If not, we need a vendor-suggested moderator or quick remote keynote via Samantha if she can join by phone.
- Customer communications: Laura, prepare a short attendee announcement (10:00) about potential schedule adjustments and where to find streaming link. Keep messaging calm and concise.

Attached floor plan and vendor contact list. LiveAV is on standby and I’m putting them on an expedited line. I’m copying venue contacts in the next thread.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

---

On Tue, Jun 30, 2026 at 08:25 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:

> From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
> To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
> Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:25:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Urgent: venue AV bridge + booth glass crack + keynote delay — recovery plan
>
> Vanessa — I made the calls while you were checking in. Quick update: 
> - LiveAV Solutions (Dispatch ID 345) confirmed ETA ~30 minutes. They've got an encoder and a spare Behringer X32 they can bring. Workorder attached (liveav-workorder-345.pdf).
> - ExpoFix quoted a 45-minute ETA for an acrylic patch and quick mount. They sent a safety quote (expofix-quote-001.pdf) — approved on my side for emergency spend.
> - Venue tech Amber at Harbor has confirmed a secondary patch panel we can route the streaming laptop into if the mixer is irreparable.
>
> Marcus — Alex Martinez is onsite as part of demos; I pinged him to confirm availability. If he can’t do full keynote moderating, he can host a short Q&A panel with product leads for 20–25 minutes.
>
> Laura — I drafted a 2-line holding message in the shared Drive. Link below. If we need to delay, we should send by 09:45.
>
> — Hannah

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: LiveAV Solutions <dispatch@liveav.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: ExpoFix Repairs <support@expofix.com>, Amber Venue Tech <amber@harborvenue.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: venue AV bridge + booth glass crack + keynote delay — recovery plan

LiveAV / ExpoFix / Amber — copying you on the current incident. Please treat this as priority for Hall B and Booth 12A. Key needs below:

- Immediate: backup mixer + encoder to Hall B, and a routing plan to attach a laptop for streaming if replacement fails.
- Booth: acrylic safety panel + mount to replace cracked glass; personnel to safely remove shards.
- Contact: Vanessa Ortiz on-site 415-555-0199 / Marcus Lin for moderator backup.

Vendor stubs attached in this thread for reference. Let me know ETAs and any access constraints.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Attachment(s): venue-floorplan.pdf

On Tue, Jun 30, 2026 at 11:05 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:

> From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
> To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, LiveAV Solutions <dispatch@liveav.com>, ExpoFix Repairs <support@expofix.com>, Amber Venue Tech <amber@harborvenue.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@thoughtworks.com>
> Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
> Subject: RE: Urgent: venue AV bridge + booth glass crack + keynote delay — recovery plan
>
> Update (final):
> - LiveAV arrived, replaced the failed mixer with backup X32 and encoder. Stream tested at 10:00 on backup route; projector replaced. Live stream to sponsor channel green. Workorder: liveav-workorder-345.pdf attached.
> - ExpoFix applied acrylic panel and removed shards safely. Booth reopened at 10:05. Quote and invoice attached (expofix-quote-001.pdf).
> - Samantha Li was able to join remotely at 10:20 and gave the keynote via remote video for 12 minutes; Alex then took the stage for a 22-minute hands-on session to fill the remaining slot.
> - Attendee comms sent at 09:47 and a short follow-up at 11:00 with the recording link.
>
> Thanks everyone for the rapid responses. Final runbook and vendor invoices attached for post-event reconciliation and ops notes.
>
> — Vanessa
>
> Attachment(s): liveav-workorder-345.pdf, expofix-quote-001.pdf, final-runbook.pdf
